title: Antique Bronze Grab Bar, 63-Inch Wall-Mounted 3-Post ADA Compliant Iron Pipe, Pipeline, Allied Brass
description: Grab bar for bathroom safety and accessibility, 63 inches long (63-inch, 63 in), wall mount / wall-mounted with a 3-post design and third center bracket for stability in Antique Bronze, which combines deep brown tones with subtle warm highlights, offering heritage appeal with modern durability. This ADA compliant bathroom grab bar (safety bar, support bar) is made from iron pipe and supports up to 250 lb. Industrial style pipe-style bath accessories look for industrial bathroom hardware, matching pipeline decor, and loft bathroom fixtures. Protected by a highly durable powder coat finish for corrosion-free and rust-free performance. Overall dimensions: 63 in L x 3 in H x 3.58 in projection (3.58-inch). Use as a bathroom grab bar along a shower wall, tub area, or near the toilet for secure balance. Limited lifetime warranty. Allied Brass Pipeline collection.
